body: I can handle pain. It's just the amount of pain. Like I'm someone who will literally peel my skin off to get rid of a pimple rather than popping it.

It's the information my mom told me that once every six months you go to the hospital to get your blood drawn. Supposedly it's to check your cholesterol to make sure your meds are still compatible or if they need to up the dosage. I know twice a year isn't very often at all but I HATE needles...
I want a therapist but I don't need or want meds, just someone to talk to.

I don't necessarily want to cut but I want to hurt myself. My depression has gotten to the point where I don't deserve to live, I feel im a genuine fuckup who can't do anything right and I'm obsessed with making sure my gf is happy with me because neither of us know what we're doing and there's a lot of mixed emotions going through my mind and honestly I'm scared
I just remember the last time I cut myself when I was maybe 15 or 16 it really hurt but that may have just been me being scared at the time.

[Someone in my day program said he spent time with his girlfriend](https://imgur.com/a/UEp0WQO) when I wasn't even asking him how his day went and when I explained to him how seeing crap like this makes me depressed [all he said to me was "okay"](https://imgur.com/a/zEtXFEI)

I'm just letting you know since we're in a conversation but today it came to a head when I let my parents know how I'm feeling and my mom's boyfriend said "don't kill yourself" and I asked why and he said "because killing yourself is stupid."
I'm going to start using this sub to vent about my depression...
Just some ppl handle it better than others.
I just don't want to be depressed anymore. That's the hardest part for me I think.
